7627.title: Idle-session release waits for the sweep
7627.rootCauseOneLine: Idle eligibility is checked only by a five-minute daemon interval; timeout updates and turn completion do not schedule a deadline check.

prReviews.topFinding: The open PR targets the verified timer cause; its code was not executed.

7627.proposedFix: Schedule idle deadline checks through the existing guarded manager pass and retain a fallback sweep. Do not duplicate open PR #7628.
7627.caveats: Scheduler-only deterministic reproduction repeated by the same agent in two clean checkouts. No real provider or RAM measurements. Complete test is inline; raw artifacts stay outside this public repository.
